biotools.summary: Slivka is a lightweight framework designed to package bioinformatics tools as resilient, robust HTTP-based web services. It allows researchers to run computationally intensive pipelines, such as DRSASP, and build their own web services easily.
biotools.name: Slivka: Framework for Bioinformatics Web Services
